title: Existing postinstall hook symlinks a sibling package from another directory with shell ln, then writes through it
intent: `ln -s ../react ../h` runs with a cwd inside the package, so the link lands in the package root and points at a sibling package, and a later write goes through it. Inert fixture. The source never names the install root, so co-occurrence scoring misses it; reported as a frontier case for propagation.package-mutation.
